questions.prompt: Why does `let y = x;` allow using `x` afterward when `x` is an `i32`?

options.text: `i32` implements the `Copy` trait, so stack bytes are trivially copied instead of moved

questions.prompt: What are Rust's borrowing rules for references in the same scope?

options.text: Either any number of immutable references (`&T`) OR exactly one mutable reference (`&mut T`), never both active simultaneously
